title: [Mechanism of modified Liangge San in treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome based on network pharmacology and experimental validation].
authors: Li, Quan; Wang, Meng-Meng; Nie, Shi-Nan; Sun, Hai-Jun; Tang, Cheng; Sun, Zhao-Rui
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究改良凉膈散治疗急性呼吸窘迫综合征的机制，核心是药物-靶点-疾病网络，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A network pharmacology-based strategy combined with molecular docking and in vitro validation was employed to investigate potential targets and molecular mechanisms of modified Liangge San(MLGS) against acute respiratory distress syndrome(ARDS). Active ingredients and corresponding targets of MLGS were screened out on the Traditional Chinese Medicines Systems Pharmacology(TCMSP) database, and the disease targets of ARDS were obtained by integrating GeneCards and DisGeNET database. The two were intersected to obtain the potential targets of MLGS against ARDS. Cytoscape 3.7.2 was used to construct a "Chinese medicine-active ingredient-target network" of MLGS and a "regulatory network of MLGS against ARDS". The protein-protein interaction(PPI) network was created on the STRING database platform, and the Metascape database was used to carry out Gene Ontology(GO) function enrichment analysis and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes(KEGG) pathway enrichment analysis. Subsequently, molecular docking and in vitro experiments were performed to further verify the above findings. A total of 211 active ingredients of MLGS and 54 key targets were obtained. The GO enrichment analysis obtained 709 GO entries(P<0.05), including 457 biological processes(BP), 50 cell components(CC), and 98 molecular functions(MF), mainly involved in lipopolysaccharides, response to reactive oxygen species, and apoptosis signal pathways. KEGG pathway enrichment analysis obtained 266 pathways, mainly involved in the cancer signaling pathways, advanced glycation end-products and their receptors(AGE-RAGE) signaling pathways, fluid shear stress, atherosclerosis, proteoglycan pathway in cancer, nuclear and factor kappa B(NF-kappaB) signaling pathway. Molecular docking showed that the main active ingredients bound steadily with the targets. The experiments proved that MLGS inhibited the generation of reactive oxygen species and the activation of NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby reducing apoptosis. The study shows that MLGS, through its multiple active ingredients including wogonin and luteolin, can treat ARDS by intervening in various signaling pathways such as NF-kappaB, inhibiting the inflammatory response and oxidative stress, and reducing apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 采用网络药理学策略，结合分子对接和体外验证，探讨改良凉膈散（MLGS）对抗急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）的潜在靶点和分子机制。在中药系统药理学（TCMSP）数据库中筛选MLGS的活性成分及对应靶点，并通过整合GeneCards和DisGeNET数据库获得ARDS的疾病靶点。将两者取交集，得到MLGS抗ARDS的潜在靶点。使用Cytoscape 3.7.2构建MLGS的“中药-活性成分-靶点网络”和“MLGS抗ARDS调控网络”。在STRING数据库平台上创建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并使用Metascape数据库进行基因本体（GO）功能富集分析和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集分析。随后，进行分子对接和体外实验以进一步验证上述发现。共获得MLGS的211个活性成分和54个关键靶点。GO富集分析获得709个GO条目（P<0.05），包括457个生物过程（BP）、50个细胞组分（CC）和98个分子功能（MF），主要涉及脂多糖、活性氧反应和凋亡信号通路。KEGG通路富集分析获得266条通路，主要涉及癌症信号通路、晚期糖基化终末产物及其受体（AGE-RAGE）信号通路、流体剪切应力、动脉粥样硬化、癌症中的蛋白聚糖通路、核因子κB（NF-kappaB）信号通路。分子对接显示，主要活性成分与靶点结合稳定。实验证明，MLGS抑制活性氧的产生和NF-kappaB信号通路的激活，从而减少凋亡。研究表明，MLGS通过其多种活性成分（包括汉黄芩素和木犀草素），通过干预NF-kappaB等多种信号通路，抑制炎症反应和氧化应激，并减少凋亡，从而治疗ARDS。
